title: Design System: Free Online Tools Nest

display.purpose: Responsive homepage hero with the approved broad composition.

headline.purpose: General headings; mobile and tool/guide overrides are described in DESIGN.md.

section.purpose: Shared section hierarchy without an eyebrow convention.

title.purpose: Complete wrapping names in tool discovery and related-tool cards.

body.purpose: Compact operating interfaces, navigation and supporting explanation.

reading.purpose: Article prose, prose-like information and desktop guides within 65ch.

label.purpose: Medium-weight pill button and navigation labels.

metadata.purpose: Readable secondary facts; not an eyebrow above a heading.

hindi-body.purpose: Devanagari-first local font stack and zero tracking.

code.purpose: Existing JetBrains Mono treatment; its remote font request is retained.

related-heading.purpose: Supporting prose hierarchy in Outfit, 18px and weight 550.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Campus cards and workspaces use tone instead of ambient shadow.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Tool-card hover changes tone without lifting its container.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Floating navigation; the implemented role is shared by both themes.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Light-theme Browse and search transient surfaces.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Retained primary-button transition; GSAP does not displace controls.

motion.name: photo-reveal
motion.value: scale 1.025 to 1; 1.1s; expo.out; ScrollTrigger top 95%; once
motion.purpose: Finite decorative reveal only when reduced motion is not requested.

motion.name: browse-expand
motion.purpose: Decorative enhancement after the native popover opens.

motion.name: arrow-feedback
motion.value: x 0 to 2px; y 0 to -2px; .16s; power2.out; yoyo; repeat 1
motion.purpose: One outward-and-back icon response on the implemented collection/navigation/task links.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; animation none; transition none; scroll-behavior auto; photo transform none
motion.purpose: CSS fallback and GSAP matchMedia exclusion; essential content is visible by default.

components.name: Primary task button
components.description: The shared compact pill action, bound to the active semantic colors.

components.name: Search desk field
components.description: A labelled search field; the enclosing edge carries focus. The sample illustrates the field rather than search matching.
components.css: .ds-search-label{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--color-ink,#142e5b);font-family:var(--font-sans,'Outfit Variable','Noto Sans Devanagari Variable',sans-serif);font-size:16px;font-weight:500}.ds-search-field{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;border:1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong,#6d82aa);padding:8px 12px 8px 24px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--color-canvas-soft,#f7f9ff);color:var(--color-ink,#142e5b)}.ds-search-field svg{width:22px;height:22px;flex:none;fill:currentColor}.ds-search-field input{width:100%;min-width:0;height:48px;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font-family:var(--font-sans,'Outfit Variable','Noto Sans Devanagari Variable',sans-serif);font-size:18px;caret-color:var(--color-link,#2853b5)}.ds-search-field input::placeholder{color:var(--color-body,#485d7b);opacity:1}.ds-search-field input:focus-visible{outline:0}.ds-search-field:focus-within{outline:3px solid var(--color-link,#2853b5);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:639px){.ds-search-field input{font-size:16px}.ds-search-field{padding-left:16px;gap:12px}}

components.name: Tool card
components.description: The source card's drawn category icon, complete wrapping name and quiet surface.
components.css: .ds-tool-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;min-height:152px;padding:24px;border:0;border-radius:20px;background:var(--color-canvas-soft,#f7f9ff);box-shadow:none;color:var(--color-ink,#142e5b);text-decoration:none;font-family:var(--font-sans,'Outfit Variable','Noto Sans Devanagari Variable',sans-serif);touch-action:manipulation;transition:background-color .18s,color .18s}.ds-tool-icon{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid var(--color-hairline,#b4c5e3);border-radius:12px;background:var(--color-canvas-soft-2,#d4dff5);color:var(--color-ink,#142e5b)}.ds-tool-icon svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:currentColor}.ds-tool-body{display:flex;min-width:0;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.ds-tool-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.ds-tool-row strong{min-width:0;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35;white-space:normal;overflow:visible;text-overflow:clip}.ds-tool-description{display:block;color:var(--color-body,#485d7b);font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-tool-arrow{flex:none;margin-top:4px;color:var(--color-mute,#485d7b);opacity:.55;transition:color .15s ease,opacity .15s ease,transform .15s ease}.ds-tool-card:hover{background:var(--color-canvas-soft-2,#d4dff5)}.ds-tool-card:hover .ds-tool-arrow{color:var(--color-link,#2853b5);opacity:1;transform:translateX(2px)}.ds-tool-card:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--color-link,#2853b5);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tool-card,.ds-tool-arrow{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-workspace{border:0;border-radius:24px;background:var(--color-canvas-soft,#f7f9ff);color:var(--color-ink,#142e5b);box-shadow:none;font-family:var(--font-sans,'Outfit Variable','Noto Sans Devanagari Variable',sans-serif)}.ds-workspace-top{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;padding:12px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-hairline,#b4c5e3)}.ds-guidance{flex:1;min-width:0}.ds-guidance summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;width:fit-content;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.6}.ds-guidance summary::after{content:'';width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1.5px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1.5px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg);margin:0 4px 4px}.ds-guidance[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(225deg);margin-bottom:0}.ds-guidance p{max-width:65ch;margin:8px 0 0;padding-bottom:8px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--color-mute,#485d7b)}.ds-guidance summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--color-link,#2853b5);outline-offset:3px}.ds-workspace-slot{padding:24px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-workspace-slot{padding:16px}}

narrative.overview: An approachable desk for finding a useful tool, doing a small task and understanding its result. Cool paper surfaces, cobalt controls, Outfit headings and a slim stationery photograph give the homepage character. Operating pages bring the workspace forward; guides and articles use a calmer reading rhythm. This record describes the approved local production implementation and carries no deployment, native review or AdSense approval claim.
keyCharacteristics: Paired cobalt and pale-blue semantic palettes.
Floating pill navigation and genuine search.
Stable workspaces with metadata and engagement after the tool.
Drawn category icons and measured reading columns.
Finite decorative motion with essential content visible by default.

rules.name: The Paired Palette Rule
rules.body: Use active semantic roles; dark tokens map to the same roles under html.dark.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Keep article prose, prose-like copy and guide explanation within 65ch, with deliberate paragraph, heading and list rhythm.

rules.name: The Workspace First Rule
rules.body: Keep controls and results stable and early; engagement and supporting destinations follow the workspace.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tone, spacing and borders for tool and reading groups; reserve diffuse shadow for floating and transient UI.

dos: Do use the current semantic palette in both themes and strong control edges.
Do use Outfit, Devanagari-first Hindi text and JetBrains Mono for code.
Do keep workspaces stable, focus visible and targets at least 44×44px.
Do retain 83 tools, 191 routes, 25-primary/58-secondary discovery and existing localized availability.
Do preserve processing, content truth, SEO/publishing, GA4, exact AdSense membership and Cloudflare configuration.
donts: Don't restore the superseded Vercel visual authority.
Don't pin or displace working controls/results or hide essential content behind motion.
Don't replace drawn icons with glyphs/emoji or add kickers/eyebrows above headings.
Don't invent translations, dates, guarantees, traffic, endorsements or approval claims.
Don't treat sampled screenshots or source checks as full browser verification.
